title: Raw extraction baseline — ready for iterative derivations

format.authority: UTF-8 source-separated JSONL with page/cell provenance and original PDFs
format.storage: Separate compressed source archives; existing split ZIP query-index package

derivation_policy.uncertain_values: Retain original text, nulls, and confidence/status; never convert missing to zero
derivation_policy.source_isolation: Keep six sources independent; compare with links, never silently merge
derivation_policy.raw_mutation: Never overwrite m02-raw-v1. Every improved extraction gets a new version and parent baseline reference
derivation_policy.publication: Public metadata only in this commit. Website population is a subsequent iteration; party-specific vendor data remains private

limitations: Exact OCR language-pack configuration not recorded in inspected page/source records
Candidate numeric roles and recipes may be wrong; apply explicit corrections during derivation
Public website was not modified by this freeze
runtime_note: Local processing runtime disconnected during freeze; existing efficient source archives and index preserved without repackaging
